en: My conditioning's in top form!
Huh?\nSomething's not right…
The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…
It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!
You're a master at this.
You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.
I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!
Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?
From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.
Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.
You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.
Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.
You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!
I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!
The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!
I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!
Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.
For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.
LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!
LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…
LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.
LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?
NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!
NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…
NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?
NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?
SEVAULT CANYON\nTANOBY RUINS AHEAD

Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.
